Aisha (Finance): FYI - tonight's invoice batch (2026-03-22) produced some invoices with the surcharge line missing and a few duplicate invoice IDs. Affected tenants reported: Veratone, Zenith Labs, marketplace vendor (ID market-v-11). Sample: INV-20260322-8791 missing surcharge.

Sam (Billing Eng): Can you attach the job log snippet or CSV?

Aisha (Finance): Log excerpt: WARN job=invoice-run id=463 tenant=veratone invoice=INV-20260322-8791 line_items=[] total=1200.00; ERROR validation missing_lines surcharge_line for INV-20260322-8791; INFO duplicate_key tenant=zenith invoice_ids=[INV-20260322-8820,INV-20260322-8820].

billing-bot: InvoiceJob#463 status=partial_failure tenants=[veratone,zenith,market-v-11] failures=18 duplicates=3 missing_lines=12

Raj (Payments): Do we know if any automated collections went through for these invoices? If so we need to stop the dunning flow and draft void notices.

Lina (Support): Veratone already opened ticket FIN-5238 - they say two PDFs arrived with the same invoice id but different totals.

Sam (Billing Eng): Investigated: race between pricing_adjustments update and proration step. Pricing join returned NULL when the experiment row was modified concurrently, so surcharge rows got filtered out. SQL used: SELECT li.* FROM line_items li LEFT JOIN pricing_adjustments pa ON (li.sku=pa.sku AND pa.active) WHERE li.amount_cents>0 AND NOT pa.experiment_disabled -- missing pa.effective_ts <= invoice_period_end filter.

Aisha (Finance): Action items: 1) Pause sends for affected tenants, 2) patch join to include effective_ts <= invoice_period_end, 3) dry-run regen to confirm lines return, 4) if PDFs sent, void + reissue + customer notice. Who owns send pause and patch?

Sam (Billing Eng): I'll own the code fix and dry-run. Pushing branch fix/billing-surcharge-join now. ETA ~40m for deploy + dry-run.

Raj (Payments): I'll pause any scheduled collections for the tenant list and prepare void & corrected templates.

Lina (Support): I'll update Veratone and Zenith tickets, telling them were pausing collection and investigating.

Sam (Billing Eng): Dry-run complete on staging snapshots: 12 invoices would be regenerated, surcharge lines restored, no duplicate ids after fix. Ready to schedule targeted regen+reissue.

Aisha (Finance): Approvals: Finance OK for targeted reissue once engineering confirms no further duplicates. Support to send customer communications. Raj to execute void/reissue flow.

billing-bot: Mitigation note created billing-ops/#BILL-2026-03-22-INV-GLITCH state=mitigated
